passages.text: The following Management’s Discussion and Analysis (“MD&A”) is intended to assist in an understanding of our financial condition and results of operations for fiscal 2025 compared with fiscal 2024. A discussion of fiscal 2024 compared to fiscal 2023 can be found in Part II. Item 7. Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations included in our Annual Report on Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended January 3, 2025 (our “Fiscal 2024 Form 10-K”) . This MD&A is provided as a supplement to, should be read in conjunction with and is qualified in its entirety by reference to, our Consolidated Financial Statements and accompanying Notes appearing elsewhere in this Report. Except for the historical information contained herein, the discussions in this MD&A contain forward-looking statements that involve risks and uncertainties. Our future results could differ materially from those discussed herein. Factors that could cause or contribute to such differences include, but are not limited to, those discussed in Part I. Item 1A. Risk Factors of this Report. For additional information, see Part I. Item 1. Business - Cautionary Statement Regarding Forward-Looking Statements of this Report. OVERVIEW We are the Trusted Disruptor in the defense industry. With customers’ mission-critical needs in mind, we deliver end-to-end technology solutions connecting the space, air, land, sea and cyber domains in the interest of national security. We support customers in more than 100 countries, with our largest customers being various departments and agencies of the U.S. Government, their prime contractors and international allies. Our capabilities have defense _____________________________________________________________________ 20 and civil government applications, as well as commercial applications. As of January 2, 2026, we had approximately 45,000 employees, including approximately 18,000 engineers and scientists. We structure our operations primarily around the capabilities we provide and we report our financial results in four business segments: CS, SAS, IMS, and AR. Revenue is disaggregated at the segment level into categories that the Chief Operating Decision Maker (“CODM”) believes best depict the nature, amount, timing, and uncertainty of revenue and cash flows. These categories do not distinguish between product and service revenue because management evaluates the business on a combined, consolidated revenue and cost of revenue basis. The CODM, as well as segment management, are not provided with and do not review revenue or cost of revenue disaggregated between products and services at the segment or sector level; accordingly, this information is not used in resource allocation decisions. Accordingly, and because we do not believe such disaggregation assists in an understanding of our financial condition and results of operations, product and service revenue and the related cost of revenue are not disaggregated herein. See Note 14: Business Segments in the Notes for further information regarding our business segments. credit_strengths.text: Operating cash flow covers capital spending comfortably, leaving substantial free cash flow that funds dividends and buybacks without incremental borrowing. This internally generated liquidity is the primary support for the investment-grade profile, and it reduces reliance on capital markets for routine funding needs.

The debt stack is entirely fixed-rate and unsecured, with maturities laddered across many years and no meaningful concentration in any single year. This structure limits refinancing risk and keeps interest costs predictable, which is favorable relative to peers carrying floating-rate or shorter-dated obligations.

key_risks.text: Leverage sits well above the sector median, and the indicative financial risk profile is significant, driven by the weaker of leverage and cash-flow coverage. Headroom to the next leverage threshold is thin, so a modest EBITDA decline or incremental debt-funded action could pressure the profile.

The debt note discloses a change-of-control repurchase obligation triggered by a below-investment-grade rating event, alongside near-term maturities. A ratings downgrade combined with a control change could force refinancing at an inopportune time, and the upcoming maturities require proactive liquidity management.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Interest coverage is adequate but materially below the sector median, reflecting the debt load carried since the acquisition. Cash interest paid is used as the interest-cost proxy because no income-statement interest expense tag was reported, so coverage should be read with that limitation in mind.

Free cash flow to debt is below the sector median, and shareholder distributions absorb most of free cash flow, leaving limited retained cash for deleveraging. The current ratio is also below the sector median, indicating a tighter working-capital position than peers.

overall_credit_view.text: The issuer is a large defense technology supplier with recurring U.S. government revenue and a laddered fixed-rate debt structure. Cash generation is solid, but leverage and coverage compare unfavorably with sector medians, and the indicative risk profile is significant rather than strong.

Our forward view is that the credit can stabilize if free cash flow is directed to debt reduction rather than shareholder returns. Continued distributions at current levels would keep leverage elevated and leave little cushion against the next threshold, so we would monitor capital allocation closely.

credit_strengths.text: 營運現金流足以輕鬆覆蓋資本開支，留下大量自由現金流，可在不增加借貸的情況下為股息及回購提供資金。此內部產生的流動性為投資級別狀況的主要支撐，並降低對資本市場應付日常資金需求的依賴。
債務結構全為固定利率及無抵押，到期日分散於多個年度，並無任何單一年度出現有意義的集中。此結構限制再融資風險，並使利息成本保持可預測，相對於背負浮動利率或較短年期債務的同業而言屬有利。

key_risks.text: 槓桿水平遠高於行業中位數，而指示性財務風險狀況屬顯著，受槓桿及現金流覆蓋兩者中較弱一項所帶動。距離下一個槓桿門檻的緩衝空間薄弱，因此EBITDA溫和下跌或增量債務融資行動可能對該狀況構成壓力。
債務票據披露一項因評級降至投資級以下事件而觸發的控制權變更回購義務，同時存在短期到期債務。評級下調結合控制權變更可能迫使在不合適的時機進行再融資，而即將到期的債務需要主動的流動性管理。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 利息覆蓋率屬足夠，但顯著低於行業中位數，反映自收購以來所背負的債務負擔。由於並無呈報損益表利息開支標籤，故以已付現金利息作為利息成本代理，因此解讀覆蓋率時應考慮此限制。
自由現金流對債務比率低於行業中位數，而股東分派吸收大部分自由現金流，留下有限保留現金用於去槓桿。流動比率亦低於行業中位數，顯示營運資金狀況較同業緊張。

overall_credit_view.text: 發行人為大型國防科技供應商，擁有經常性的美國政府收入及分散的固定利率債務結構。現金產生穩健，但槓桿及覆蓋率與行業中位數比較屬不利，而指示性風險狀況屬顯著而非強勁。
我們的前瞻觀點是，若自由現金流用於削減債務而非股東回報，信貸可趨向穩定。若按目前水平持續分派，將使槓桿維持高企，並對下一個門檻留下極少緩衝，因此我們會密切監察資本配置。
